dataTransform.transform:
[edges.node~>|$|(

$noData := $isNilOrEmpty(remainingBalance) or $isNilOrEmpty(producedQuantity) or $isNilOrEmpty(scrappedQuantity);
$noWo := $isNilOrEmpty(workOrderNumber);
$noRate := $isNilOrEmpty(standardRate);
{
"percentComplete": $noData ? "NO DATA" : producedQuantity > 0 and remainingBalance >= 0 ? $round($sum(producedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity)*100),2) & "%" 
: producedQuantity <= 0 ? "0%" : remainingBalance < 0 ? $round($sum(producedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity)*100),2) & "%"
, 

 "scrapPercent": $noData ? "NO DATA" : scrappedQuantity <= 0 ? "0.00%" : $round($sum((scrappedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity))*100),2) & "%"
, 

 "runTime":  $noRate ? "NO RATE" : $noData ? "NO DATA" : remainingBalance > 0 and standardRate > 0 and producedQuantity = 0 ? $round($sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)+setupRate),2) & " Hrs" : producedQuantity > 0 and remainingBalance >0 and standardRate >0 
? $round($sum(remainingBalance/standardRate),2) & " Hrs" : remainingBalance < 0 ? "OVER PRODUCTION" : remainingBalance = 0? "COMPLETE" : "NO RATE"
, 

 "requiredQuantity": $noData ? "No Data" : $sum(remainingBalance+producedQuantity) >= 0 ? $sum(remainingBalance+producedQuantity) : 0
, 

"estFinish": $noData or $noRate ? "NO DATA" : remainingBalance <= 0 or standardRate <= 0  ? "NA" : remainingBalance > 0 and producedQuantity = 0 
? ($e:= $sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)+setupRate); $moment().add($e,'hours') ) 
: $coalesce([remainingBalance,0]) > 0 and $coalesce([producedQuantity,0]) >0 
? ($r:= $sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)); $moment().add($r,'hours')) : 0
 ,

"producedQuantity": $noData ? "0"
,
"workOrderNumber": $noWo ? "No Work Order Loaded"
,

"outlook": $isNilOrEmpty(dueAt) ? "#cccccc" : ($moment(dueAt).diff($moment()) > 3600000 ? "#0000dd" : ($moment(dueAt).diff($moment()) > 0 ? "#ffff00" : "#dd0000"))


})|

]

props.label: Produced
props.description: Accumulation of production for the duration of this setup.

props.label: Scrap
props.description: Accumulation of rejected units for the duration of this setup.
